query:
SELECT 
  rs.id,
  rs.status,
  rs.createdAt,
  u.name,
  u.email
FROM raum36_subscriptions rs
LEFT JOIN users u ON rs.userId = u.id
WHERE rs.status = 'active'
ORDER BY rs.createdAt DESC;
